New Words:
;badna
:x<sub>1</sub> is a banana/plantain [fruit/plant] of species/breed x<sub>2</sub>.
;figre
:x<sub>1</sub> is a fig [fruit/tree] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;guzme
:x<sub>1</sub> is a melon/squash [fruit/plant] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;jbari
:x<sub>1</sub> is a berry (fruit/plant) of plant/species x<sub>2</sub>.
;narge
:x<sub>1</sub> is a nut [body-part: hard-shelled fruit] from plant/species x<sub>2</sub> with shell x<sub>3</sub> and kernel x<sub>4</sub>.
;nimre
:x<sub>1</sub> is a quantity of citrus [fruit/tree, etc.] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;perli
:x<sub>1</sub> is a pear [fruit] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;plise
:x<sub>1</sub> is an apple [fruit] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;tamca
:x<sub>1</sub> is a tomato [fruit/vegetable/plant] of species/strain x<sub>2</sub>.
;grute
:x<sub>1</sub> is a fruit [body-part] of species x<sub>2</sub>.
